Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简

x2+x−6x2−9​ and x−2x−3​ give the same output for almost every x — but at x=−3 the first one breaks. Knowing exactly where is half the marks.x2+x−6x2−9​ 和 x−2x−3​ 几乎对所有 x 都相等——但在 x=−3 处前者没有意义。准确找出这些点就拿到了一半的分。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
  1. NPVs: values that make the DENOMINATOR zero — factor it, set each factor =0.不允许值：使分母为零的值——把分母分解，每个因式 =0。
  2. State NPVs from the ORIGINAL expression; a cancelled factor still counts.从原式写不允许值；约掉的因式照样算。
  3. Cancel FACTORS, never terms; b−aa−b​=−1.只能约因式，不能约项；b−aa−b​=−1。
BCAC​=BA​,B=0, C=0
b−aa−b​=−1,a=b

🧗 The hard part难点 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简

A denominator that starts with −x2分母以 −x2 开头

The opposite factor is hidden until you take out −1, and the sign of the answer flips.不提出 −1 就看不出相反因式，而且结果要变号。

  1. 6−x−x2=−(x2+x−6)=−(x+3)(x−2)
  2. NPVs now: x=−3, 2现在写不允许值：x=−3, 2
  3. 6−x−x22x2−8​=−(x+3)(x−2)2(x−2)(x+2)​=−x+32(x+2)​
Try试一试
Simplify 10+3x−x2x2−25​ and state the NPVs.化简 10+3x−x2x2−25​，并写出不允许值。
Answer答案
−(x−5)(x+2)(x−5)(x+5)​=−x+2x+5​, x=5, −2−(x−5)(x+2)(x−5)(x+5)​=−x+2x+5​，x=5, −2

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
  • x+3x+6​=36​ ✗ → nothing cancels across +.x+3x+6​=36​ ✗ → 加号连接的不能约。
  • Setting the numerator =0 for NPVs ✗ → only the denominator matters.令分子为 0 求不允许值 ✗ → 只看分母。
🎯
Write the NPVs on line 1, before simplifying — then you cannot lose them.第一行先写不允许值，再化简——就不会丢。

cards.f: Where do NPVs come from?不允许值从哪里来？
cards.b: Denominator =0, in the original expression.原式的分母 =0。

cards.f: 7−xx−7​ = ?7−xx−7​＝？
cards.b: −1, x=7.−1，x=7。

cards.f: Can you cancel the x in xx+2​?xx+2​ 中的 x 能约吗？
cards.b: No — x is a term on top, not a factor.不能——分子里 x 是项，不是因式。

cards.f: NPVs of x2+41​?x2+41​ 的不允许值？
cards.b: None: x2+4 is never 0.没有：x2+4 永远不为 0。

cards.f: First move to simplify?化简的第一步？
cards.b: Factor top and bottom completely.分子分母完全分解。

quiz.q: State the NPV of x−57​.写出 x−57​ 的不允许值。
quiz.hint: When is x−5=0?什么时候 x−5=0？
quiz.ans: x=5
quiz.why: x−5=0 at x=5, so x=5.x=5 时 x−5=0，所以 x=5。

quiz.q: Simplify x+2x2−4​.化简 x+2x2−4​。
opts: x−2, x=−2
x−2, no restrictionx−2，无不允许值
x+2, x=−2
x2−2
quiz.hint: Difference of squares on top.分子是平方差。
quiz.ans: x−2, x=−2x−2，x=−2
quiz.why: x+2(x−2)(x+2)​=x−2, x=−2.x+2(x−2)(x+2)​=x−2，x=−2。

quiz.q: State the NPVs of x2+5x+6x+1​.写出 x2+5x+6x+1​ 的不允许值。
quiz.hint: Factor x2+5x+6.分解 x2+5x+6。
quiz.ans: x=−2, −3
quiz.why: (x+2)(x+3), so x=−2 and x=−3.(x+2)(x+3)，所以 x=−2 且 x=−3。

quiz.q: Simplify 6xy34x2y​ and state the NPVs.化简 6xy34x2y​，写出不允许值。
quiz.hint: Both x and y appear in the denominator.分母里同时有 x 和 y。
quiz.ans: 3y22x​, x=0, y=03y22x​，x=0，y=0
quiz.why: 64​=32​, xx2​=x, y3y​=y21​. NPVs from 6xy3: x=0, y=0.64​=32​，xx2​=x，y3y​=y21​。由 6xy3 得 x=0，y=0。

quiz.q: Simplify x2−9x2+2x−15​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2−9x2+2x−15​，写出不允许值。
quiz.hint: (x+5)(x−3) over (x−3)(x+3).(x+5)(x−3) 比 (x−3)(x+3)。
quiz.ans: x+3x+5​, x=±3x+3x+5​，x=±3
quiz.why: Cancel (x−3): x+3x+5​. NPVs from the original: x=3,−3.约去 (x−3)：x+3x+5​。原式的不允许值：x=3,−3。

quiz.q: Simplify x2−4x+410−5x​ and state the NPV.化简 x2−4x+410−5x​，写出不允许值。
quiz.hint: Top =−5(x−2); bottom =(x−2)2.分子 =−5(x−2)；分母 =(x−2)2。
quiz.ans: −x−25​, x=2−x−25​，x=2
quiz.why: (x−2)2−5(x−2)​=−x−25​, x=2.(x−2)2−5(x−2)​=−x−25​，x=2。

quiz.q: Which is equivalent to 3−xx−3​?下列哪个与 3−xx−3​ 等价？
opts: 1
−1, x=3
0
−xx​
quiz.hint: Top and bottom are opposites.分子分母互为相反数。
quiz.ans: −1, x=3−1，x=3
quiz.why: 3−x=−(x−3), so the fraction is −1 for every x=3.3−x=−(x−3)，所以对所有 x=3，结果是 −1。

quiz.q: A club rents a hall. Its average cost per member (in hundreds of dollars) is modelled by A(n)=n2−9n2+2n−15​, where n is the number of members. (a) Simplify A(n) and state all non-permissible values. (b) A treasurer enters n=3 into the simplified form and reports $133 per member. Explain why the original model gives no answer at n=3, so the report cannot be trusted. (c) Find A(5) both ways, and say what A(n) approaches when the club becomes very large.某俱乐部租一个场地，每位会员的平均费用（以百加元计）建模为 A(n)=n2−9n2+2n−15​，其中 n 是会员人数。(a) 化简 A(n) 并写出所有不允许值。(b) 财务把 n=3 代入化简式，报告每人 $133。解释为什么原模型在 n=3 时没有答案，所以这个报告不可信。(c) 用两种方式求 A(5)，并说明会员很多时 A(n) 趋近于什么。
quiz.hint: Factor both parts. For the long-run value rewrite n+3n+5​=1+n+32​.两部分都分解。求长期值时把 n+3n+5​ 改写成 1+n+32​。
quiz.ans: (a) A(n)=n+3n+5​, n=±3; (b) the original has denominator 0 at n=3; (c) A(5)=45​ ($125), tending to 1 ($100).(a) A(n)=n+3n+5​，n=±3；(b) 原式在 n=3 时分母为 0；(c) A(5)=45​（$125），趋近于 1（$100）。
quiz.why: (n−3)(n+3)(n+5)(n−3)​=n+3n+5​, with n=3 and n=−3 from the original denominator.(n−3)(n+3)(n+5)(n−3)​=n+3n+5​，原分母给出 n=3 和 n=−3。
